title: Chess game with Gaddafi on Russia Day

tellings.quote: was nowhere to be seen. And then I arrived. It was the 12th of June, Russia day.

plain: In 2011, in Tripoli, Libya, a Russian regional leader went to see Muammar Gaddafi, Libya's ruler, during the war there and played chess with him. The teller is the former president of one of Russia's republics, who also says he was taken by aliens in 1997, and he tells it as something he did himself: at first Gaddafi "was nowhere to be seen," and then "I arrived. It was the 12th of June, Russia day." He tells it to show the unusual access he had to world leaders.
